repo_summary: a lightweight analytics repo with a Jupyter notebook, CSV metrics, and a Python export script for weekly support operations reporting
key_files: analysis/weekly_ops_report.ipynb captures the analyst workflow and narrative checkpoints
scripts/export_report.py converts CSV data into outputs/weekly_report.json
data/weekly_metrics.csv is the source dataset used by both the notebook and the export script
tests/test_report.py verifies the exported report stays consistent
realism_notes: Natural asks often mention keeping the notebook and export script in sync
Teams usually want one extra briefing artifact such as markdown or anomaly notes
The task should stay small enough for a single agent pass, not a full analytics platform rewrite
